```{=html}
<style>
  body { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; }

  .status-panel {
    max-width: 480px;
    margin: 2rem auto;
    padding: 2rem;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    border-radius: 16px;
    color: #eee;
  }

  .status-panel h2 {
    margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0;
    font-size: 1.4rem;
    color: #fff;
  }

  .status-panel p.subtitle {
    margin: 0 0 1.5rem 0;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: #888;
  }

  .btn-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .btn-grid button {
    padding: 16px 10px;
    border: 2px solid transparent;
    border-radius: 10px;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
  }

  .btn-grid button:active { transform: scale(0.96); }
  .btn-grid button.active { border-color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }

  .btn-available { background: #2d6a4f; color: #fff; }
  .btn-available:hover { background: #40916c; }
  .btn-teaching  { background: #9d4edd; color: #fff; }
  .btn-teaching:hover { background: #b07ae8; }
  .btn-meeting   { background: #e76f51; color: #fff; }
  .btn-meeting:hover { background: #f4845f; }
  .btn-busy      { background: #c1121f; color: #fff; }
  .btn-busy:hover { background: #d63c3c; }
  .btn-away      { background: #555; color: #fff; }
  .btn-away:hover { background: #777; }

  .status-msg {
    margin-top: 1rem;
    padding: 10px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    text-align: center;
    min-height: 1.2em;
  }
  .status-msg.ok   { background: #2d6a4f33; color: #52b788; }
  .status-msg.err  { background: #c1121f33; color: #f4845f; }
  .status-msg.load { background: #ffffff11; color: #aaa; }

  .setup-section {
    max-width: 480px;
    margin: 1rem auto;
    padding: 1rem 2rem;
    background: #16213e;
    border-radius: 12px;
    color: #ccc;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
  }
  .setup-section summary { cursor: pointer; color: #aaa; }
  .setup-section input {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 8px;
    margin: 8px 0;
    border: 1px solid #333;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: #0f1626;
    color: #eee;
    font-family: monospace;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }
  .setup-section button {
    padding: 6px 16px;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: #2d6a4f;
    color: white;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
  }

  .current-label {
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: #888;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
  }
  .current-label span {
    color: #52b788;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
</style>

<div class="status-panel">
  <h2>🚪 Door Display</h2>
  <p class="subtitle">Updates your office e-ink display within 2 minutes</p>

  <div class="current-label">Current: <span id="currentStatus">checking...</span></div>

  <div class="btn-grid">
    <button class="btn-available" onclick="setStatus('available')">✓ Available</button>
    <button class="btn-teaching"  onclick="setStatus('teaching')">✕ Teaching</button>
    <button class="btn-meeting"   onclick="setStatus('meeting')">✕ In a Meeting</button>
    <button class="btn-busy"      onclick="setStatus('busy')">✕ Do Not Disturb</button>
    <button class="btn-away"      onclick="setStatus('away')">— Away</button>
  </div>

  <div id="statusMsg" class="status-msg"></div>
</div>

<div class="setup-section">
  <details>
    <summary>⚙ Setup (first time only)</summary>
    <p>Create a <a href="https://github.com/settings/tokens/new?scopes=gist&description=Door+Display" target="_blank" style="color:#52b788">GitHub token</a> with <code>gist</code> scope, paste it below. It's stored only in your browser.</p>
    <input type="password" id="tokenInput" placeholder="ghp_xxxxxxxxxxxx">
    <button onclick="saveToken()">Save token</button>
  </details>
</div>

<script>
const GIST_ID = 'b692a660de04a35fee9018ea6bf4d15e';
const FILENAME = 'status.txt';
const RAW_URL = `https://gist.githubusercontent.com/jlevente/${GIST_ID}/raw/${FILENAME}`;

function getToken() {
  return localStorage.getItem('door_gist_token') || '';
}

function saveToken() {
  const t = document.getElementById('tokenInput').value.trim();
  if (t) {
    localStorage.setItem('door_gist_token', t);
    showMsg('Token saved ✓', 'ok');
    document.querySelector('details').open = false;
  }
}

function showMsg(msg, type) {
  const el = document.getElementById('statusMsg');
  el.textContent = msg;
  el.className = 'status-msg ' + type;
  if (type === 'ok') setTimeout(() => { el.textContent = ''; el.className = 'status-msg'; }, 3000);
}

function highlightActive(status) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.btn-grid button').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  const map = { available: 0, teaching: 1, meeting: 2, busy: 3, away: 4 };
  const idx = map[status];
  if (idx !== undefined) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.btn-grid button')[idx].classList.add('active');
  }
  document.getElementById('currentStatus').textContent = status || '—';
}

async function fetchCurrent() {
  try {
    const r = await fetch(RAW_URL + '?t=' + Date.now());
    const s = (await r.text()).trim().toLowerCase();
    highlightActive(s);
  } catch(e) {
    document.getElementById('currentStatus').textContent = 'error';
  }
}

async function setStatus(status) {
  const token = getToken();
  if (!token) {
    showMsg('Set up your GitHub token first ↓', 'err');
    document.querySelector('details').open = true;
    return;
  }

  showMsg('Updating...', 'load');

  try {
    const r = await fetch(`https://api.github.com/gists/${GIST_ID}`, {
      method: 'PATCH',
      headers: {
        'Authorization': `token ${token}`,
        'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json'
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ files: { [FILENAME]: { content: status + '\n' } } })
    });

    if (r.ok) {
      highlightActive(status);
      showMsg(`Set to "${status}" ✓ — display updates within 2 min`, 'ok');
    } else {
      const d = await r.json();
      showMsg('Error: ' + (d.message || r.status), 'err');
    }
  } catch(e) {
    showMsg('Network error: ' + e.message, 'err');
  }
}

// Check current status on load
fetchCurrent();
</script>
```
